scope: Read-only CPU tokenization using the existing server environment; no model weights loaded and no GPU inference or training
method: AutoTokenizer(local_files_only=True); get_template_and_fix_tokenizer; encode_multiturn on each system/user/assistant triple; existing Factory infer_seqlen(source_length, target_length, cutoff_len - efficient_eos)
